description: WCH CH340B USB to serial bridge, SOP-16, internal clock and EEPROM, 3.3 V or 5 V supply

pinout.name: V3
pinout.notes: internal 3.3 V node: tie to VCC at 3.3 V supply, 0.1uF decoupling at 5 V

pinout.name: RST#
pinout.notes: CH340B: external reset, active low, internal pull-up

pinout.name: TNOW
pinout.notes: CH340B: serial transmit-in-progress indicator, active high

abs_max.param: VIO voltage on input or output pins

pin_ratings.source: WCH CH340 manual (1) version 3D p.5 6.1 Absolute Maximum: 'VCC 电源电压 -0.5 6.0 V' (V3 is the internal 3.3 V node tied to VCC at 3.3 V supply per p.3 section 5.1; no separate V3 rating given)
WCH CH340 manual (1) version 3D p.5 6.1 Absolute Maximum: 'VIO 输入或者输出引脚上的电压 -0.5 VCC+0.5 V'
